t: In front of you is Knife Edge Two Piece, a sculpture by Henry Moore, catalogued as being at College Green, by the Houses of Parliament. Moore is best known for his semi-abstract monumental bronze sculptures, which stand as public works of art around the world. This is one of them, set in a very public London spot. Moore also produced many drawings, including a series of Londoners sheltering from the Blitz during the Second World War.
